What's your return and refund policy?
Barkers’ return and refund policy varies depending on how you purchased your item:
For online purchases, you may return items for change of mind within 30 days of delivery. A free prepaid courier label is included, and you can return items either by post or at a Barkers store.
For in-store purchases, returns for change of mind are accepted within 14 days for a full refund. Between 14 and 30 days, you may receive an exchange or store credit.
Items must be in original condition, unwashed, and have all labels and swing tags attached. Worn, washed, damaged, or altered items cannot be returned for change of mind.
If your item is faulty, Barkers will arrange a repair, replacement, refund, or store credit, depending on the issue.
Refunds are processed to the original payment method. Gift card and Barkers Dollars refunds are returned to the respective accounts. Barkers coupons are non-refundable.
Once your return reaches the warehouse, processing takes 1 to 2 days, with refunds appearing on your statement a few business days later. For Australian returns, processing may take up to 5 business days after receipt.
For in-store returns, bring your item and proof of purchase to any Barkers store. For online returns, follow the provided process and use the prepaid label if applicable.
